limitations: Local Foundry with time warp; does not replace public-chain real-clock P6.
This is the covered contract envelope, not a proof over unbounded arbitrary inputs.
No external transaction, new funding or deployment occurred.

sourceBinding.basis: Parent recorded clean source and stand ownership; input summary preserves these observations. Log files do not independently embed the source SHA.

gas.command: bun tools/stand-lock.ts run --reason "current-contract-funding-exit-cef42c616" --timeout-ms "60000" -- forge test --root jurisdictions --match-contract "Dispute(GasAdmission|IngressGas|CounterGas)Test|FundingExitTest" --fuzz-seed "0x20261012" -vv
gas.source: Exact first line of gas log.

bytecode.source: Existing checker identified by EXIT_GAS_PRODUCTION_BYTECODE_OK; checker source pinned above.

fuzzCoverage.seedClassification: Public reproducibility parameter, not a signer secret.

fundingLifecycle.unit: ERC20 token base units in the Foundry fixture
steps: Deposit 300 to the funder reserve and 40 to a third-party reserve using actual ERC20 custody and signed batches.
Prepare the counterparty-signed one-asset exit proof; fund via R2C 100, unilateral top-up 50, and third-party top-up 40. Assert collateral = 190.
With the counterparty offline after signing, the funder starts and finalizes a timed dispute for a signed payment of 60. Assert funder reserve = 280, counterparty reserve = 60, collateral = 0.
Prepare a fresh signed proof with nonce 4, fund 10 after complete exit, and complete a second unilateral dispute exit.
Redeem 280 ERC20 from reserve to the funder wallet. Assert wallet receipt = 280 and Depository custody = 60 for the peer reserve.
fundingLifecycle.interpretation: Demonstrates first funding, unilateral and third-party top-ups, complete exit, reopen and external redemption for both lexicographic sides with signed evidence. No unsecured repayment guarantee is inferred.

gasInterpretation.assertion: Every covered _submitBudget invocation asserts conservative gas strictly below 5,000,000 and restricts execution gas after calldata overhead.
gasInterpretation.measurement: Includes 21,000 intrinsic gas plus conservative all-nonzero calldata cost; also applies the EIP-7623 calldata floor. Fixture setup is excluded.
gasInterpretation.aggregation: Budget applies separately to start, counter, reveal and finalize, not to their sum or the total Foundry test gas.
gasInterpretation.printedValues: largestPrintedGasByOperation is the largest printed sample for each operation, not an observed maximum over all fuzz invocations.
gasInterpretation.fundingDeposit: The ERC20-to-reserve deposit helper is tested semantically but has no separately printed operation gas measurement. R2C, exit and reserve redemption use _submitBudget.

bytecodeInterpretation.compared: Foundry deployed-bytecode artifacts versus production Hardhat deployed-bytecode artifacts for 8 contracts.
bytecodeInterpretation.libraryHandling: Compiler-declared link-slot positions must match; only those 20-byte slots are zeroed before exact template comparison and Keccak256 hashing.
bytecodeInterpretation.limitation: Template hashes are not deployed-address bytecode hashes. This run does not query public-chain runtime code or verify concrete public library addresses.
bytecodeInterpretation.compileObservation: Foundry log reports no changed files and compilation skipped; the bytecode checker compares the artifacts used.

secretReview.included: Measurement summary and two text logs only. No signer profiles, private keys, raw databases or recovery bundles.
